text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Today's the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, right?
Feels like there's more people than last year."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Because someone from the "Splendid Clan" is running!
It's her first target race since declaring she's taking the sprint route!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: The paper said a three-generation family sweep is on the line! Don't you wanna witness history being made?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, as for me, I'm cheering for Helios all the way as usual!
As long as she slays, anything goes!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Incredible, everyone's expectations are swirling together...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This is—a GⅠ.
The thing I've been aiming for...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...First, let's cheer on the two of them.
Good luck, Ruby, Helios!"

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text: The one who is the fastest—is the most magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "You yourself are the brilliance."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "‘You yourself are the radiance.’"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, there's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"So... your trainer mentioned
that we should be wary of Helios?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While Daitaku Helios draws curious attention as the
"Laughing Umamusume," her ability is the real deal.
She has, in fact, won graded stakes races.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will remain conscious of my positioning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We talked before about the possibility of Daitaku Helios
becoming a rival... but she still doesn't seem
to be conscious of any specific person.
choice_data_list: (I'm sure it would have a good influence, though...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Will that be all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that Daiichi Ruby has gained a new mission,
it's time for her first target race...
What she must do from now on isâ
choice_data_list: Let's go show them your speed.
Let's go show them your speed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Because that is
precisely why I am here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (Grandmother, Mother, and everyone of our family... From this point on, I shall begin a new stride.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(What I should do, and what constitutes
having accomplished it... remains unclear.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... I swear to reach the goal
faster than anyone else—)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Milaaadyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real...
There's a legit rich lady right there...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
S-S-S-So freaking awesome~~~!!
Hype! Hype!! Max hype-maro!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is a pleasure to work with you today.
Well then.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Wait!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's all!?
Man, you're being so salty, but roger that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But... we're in the same race, y'know?!
Seriously, not even a little...
'bring it on' or anything?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Not especially.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna!
Run my heart out!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Max hype, totally pumped!
If we do that, then m'lady's definitely gonna――"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The vibes are gonna get
totaaaally insane, I swear!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please, feel free.
However...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Because what I must set my eyes upon lies much further ahead.
